confidence_note: Checked against book text (Become a Student). Old text dropped: generic list of fallen generals and artists, Holiday seeking experts before each book, the "ego quiet" quote. Replaced by Hammett/Satriani, Shamrock, Epictetus which the book contains.
facts: Early 1980s April: Metallica told guitarist Dave Mustaine he was out in a decrepit New York warehouse and handed him a bus ticket to San Francisco; Kirk Hammett (Exodus, barely in his twenties) got the job and played first show days later.
Around then Hammett realized he was not as good as he wanted to be and looked for a teacher in San Francisco, insisting he was still a student.
Joe Satriani taught from a small music shop in Berkeley, a teacher's teacher whose students included Steve Vai.
Satriani: Hammett was already good (shredding, great right hand, most chords) but had not learned names and how things connect.

Rules: weekly lessons, lessons must be learned or Hammett wastes everyone's time; many peers stormed out calling him too harsh; Hammett stayed two years weekly, later brought riffs from the band and learned to do more with fewer notes.
Hammett became a great metal guitarist; Satriani sharpened his own technique.
Holiday: being a student puts ego in someone else's hands; an education cannot be hacked; Epictetus: impossible to learn what one thinks one already knows.
Frank Shamrock: plus, minus, equal: someone better, someone lesser to teach, an equal to test against.
tension: He had made it into his dream band and still hired a strict teacher.
opening_idea: Open on the weekly-lesson rule or on friends storming out.

lessons.idea: Put your own assessment in someone else's hands for a while.
lessons.anchor: Hammett booked weekly lessons after joining Metallica.
lessons.everyday_example_idea: A new hire asks a senior colleague to mark weak points in each weekly report.

reflect_final: In an area where you already feel competent, whom could you ask this month for blunt feedback on a piece of your work?

use_cases.situation: You are about to send a first report.
use_cases.move: Ask a colleague to find weak spots.
Ask for monthly review, citing Hammett's weekly lessons.

use_cases.situation: You think you have made it.
use_cases.move: Ask what you can still learn this week from someone better.

pocket_idea: Where you feel arrived, find a teacher.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: Kirk Hammett joined Metallica, then looked for a guitar teacher.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: Hammett got Mustaine's place, knew he was not good enough and took weekly lessons from strict Joe Satriani for two years while peers stormed out. Holiday: ego goes into the teacher's hands.
